items.name: Tarun Nagar
items.bio: Leads the studio's direction, client relationships and production planning. Founded Brothers Interactive in 2017 with the goal of building a character team that ships games rather than only portfolio pieces.

items.name: Arun Nagar
items.bio: Part of the founding leadership. Works across art quality and day-to-day studio operations, keeping the team's output consistent from the first blockout to final engine delivery.

items.name: Sourabh Gupta
items.bio: Senior member of the leadership group with a focus on character production and mentoring artists through the studio's pipeline.

items.name: Kamlesh Bagara
items.bio: Senior member of the leadership group, working on asset quality, technical standards and engine-ready delivery for client projects.
